statement: The CCPA applies to a for-profit entity doing business in California that meets any one of: annual gross revenues over $25,000,000 in the preceding calendar year (as CPI-adjusted under § 1798.199.95(d)); annually buying, selling, or sharing the personal information of 100,000 or more consumers or households; or deriving 50 percent or more of annual revenues from selling or sharing consumers' personal information (Civ. Code § 1798.140(d)(1)(A)-(C)).
caveat: The revenue figure is inflation-adjusted, so the operative threshold exceeds the $25,000,000 printed in the statute; service-provider and contractor obligations can apply to startups below the thresholds through their customers' contracts. This repo does not determine CCPA applicability.
